description: Source code for the Blit9 class, a utility for surface copying and blitting operations in Direct3D 9 within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Blit9
classes.description: A utility class for performing surface blit and copy operations in Direct3D 9, including shader management, state saving/restoring, and rendering.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the geometry and shaders needed for blit operations.

methods.name: setShader
methods.description: Sets the specified shader (vertex or pixel) for rendering.

methods.name: getSurfaceRect
methods.description: Returns the RECT dimensions of a surface.

methods.name: getSurfaceSize
methods.description: Returns the size (width, height, depth) of a surface.

methods.name: boxFilter
methods.description: Performs a box filter (blit with linear filtering) from source to destination surface.

methods.name: copy2D
methods.description: Copies a 2D framebuffer attachment to a surface.

methods.name: copyCube
methods.description: Copies a framebuffer attachment to a cube map face.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies a texture to another texture or surface, with optional format conversion.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs the actual copy or blit operation between surfaces, using StretchRect if possible or format conversion shaders.

methods.name: formatConvert
methods.description: Converts the format of a surface using shaders.

methods.name: setFormatConvertShaders
methods.description: Selects and sets the appropriate shaders for format conversion based on destination format and alpha premultiplication.

methods.name: copySurfaceToTexture
methods.description: Copies a surface into a texture.

methods.name: setViewportAndShaderConstants
methods.description: Sets viewport and shader constants for blit operations.

methods.name: setCommonBlitState
methods.description: Configures common render states for blit operations.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Executes the draw call for the blit.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current device state before rendering.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the device state after rendering.
